title: Step 61-C shared Product Detail data and rendering foundation
description: Implement only the shared Storefront Product Detail foundation on top of the canonical Step 61-B backend/OpenAPI contract: generated-OpenAPI-derived Product Detail/variant/media/specification types, a server-only GET /products/{slug} loader using the existing customer-session bridge and inherited failure-state policy, an authoritative summary presentation primitive, logical RTL/responsive styling, and deterministic Stage-C verification. Keep the /product/:slug route as the existing Step-61 placeholder. Do not start variant interaction, variant endpoint fetching, rich-media interaction, cart mutation, related-content orchestration, SEO finalization, backend/API/database changes, or new dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Product Detail, variant, media and specification Storefront types are aliases of generated OpenAPI success/schema types; no parallel authoritative DTO is created.

The shared loader performs only server-side GET /products/{slug} through the existing customer-session bridge, preserves backend authority, inherits safe read recovery, and does not expose browser Authorization or unrelated cookies.

The summary primitive renders only authoritative product identity/category/current Toman price fields and honestly represents missing price without fabricating stock, discount, media, availability or variant decisions.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront product-detail-foundation:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/storefront static-quality

acceptance_criteria.description: Stage 61-C keeps /product/:slug as the existing placeholder and does not fetch /products/{slug}/variants, mutate Cart, implement rich-media interaction, related content or final SEO; those remain owned by 61-D through 61-G.

Canonical completion requires root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, applicable Storefront quality checks, deterministic review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before Stage 61-D begins.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 61-C is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 61-D remains blocked until protected transport, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release are green.
